info.title: Lost Crypto API
info.description: Backend da plataforma Lost Crypto: dados de mercado, estratégias, backtests e paper trading.

get.description: Readiness: the process is up and the database is reachable.
Liveness: the process is running (no dependencies checked).

Is the worker alive? 503 when its heartbeat is older than WORKER_STALE_AFTER_SECONDS.

For a monitor OUTSIDE this host (book 1 ch. 4, O3): the only way to learn that the whole
machine is down while nobody has the app open. Unauthenticated and without sensitive data.

post.description: Sign in. Returns the access token and sets the refresh-token cookie.
Trade the refresh cookie for a new access token (the cookie is rotated).
End this login: revokes the refresh token and clears the cookie.

get.description: The signed-in user (the frontend uses this to know the role).

post.description: Change your password; every session (including this one) is signed out.

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Auth Users Get

post.description: Create a user (admin only). Give a collaborator `viewer` for read-only access.
Disable a user and sign them out everywhere. You cannot disable yourself.

get.description: Available strategy types and their configurable parameters.

schema.title: Response List Strategies Api V1 Strategies Get

schema.title: Response List Imports Api V1 Market Data Imports Get

get.description: What is stored for a series, including detected gaps (and those inside start/end).

Close-to-close moves beyond ``k`` standard deviations (Chan suggests ~4) to review.

Flags, never deletes: crashes are real. Each one comes with the same-candle move of
BTC/USDT when stored, as a hint of a market-wide move.

schema.title: Response Get Outliers Api V1 Market Data Outliers Get

get.description: Estimate mean-reversion half-life from stored close prices; descriptive only.

Pairs the exchange listed, from daily snapshots taken by the worker.

The history starts on the day the snapshots began: older delistings are unknown.

schema.title: Response Get Listings Api V1 Market Data Listings Get

get.description: Structural breaks the operator named (global ones included when a market is given).

schema.title: Response List Regime Breaks Api V1 Market Data Regime Breaks Get

post.description:
Name a break (a crash, a rule change). Register breaks BEFORE running experiments: each one
keeps when it was created, and a break chosen after seeing results is a research freedom.

delete.description: Breaks are never edited: delete and create again, which leaves a trail.

get.description:
Correlation between the return over ``lookback`` candles and the next ``holding`` candles,
with non-overlapping samples. Descriptive: a grid is many tests, so significance is against
the corrected level; correlation is not profit.

post.description:
Queue a backtest. The worker executes it; poll ``GET /backtests/{id}`` for the result.

Results are simulations on historical data, not a forecast of future returns.

get.description: Newest first; the size of the whole list is in ``X-Total-Count``.

schema.title: Response List Backtests Api V1 Backtests Get

post.description:
Queue one backtest per parameter combination of ``grid`` and compare them.

Combinations the strategy rejects (e.g. fast >= slow) are skipped and reported. With
``test_fraction`` set, runs are ranked by the train part and the test part checks the
winner; choosing by the test part would turn it into selection data.

get.description: Several backtests side by side, in the order requested.

schema.title: Response Compare Backtests Api V1 Backtests Compare Get

parameters.name: rank_by

schema.description: Ranking criterion. Default: `train_return_pct` with a train/test split (the test part then stays a check, not a selection criterion), else `total_return_pct`.
schema.title: Rank By

parameters.description: Ranking criterion. Default: `train_return_pct` with a train/test split (the test part then stays a check, not a selection criterion), else `total_return_pct`.

post.description:
Record what you concluded from this run. Stored in the audit trail (`note.added`); read it
with `GET /audit-events?event_type=note.added&entity_id={run_id}`.

get.description:
Growth and drawdown at exposures in (0, 1], from the run's per-bar returns. Kelly is an
upper bound to discount, never a recommendation to size up; the optional bootstrap resamples
the returns (it destroys their autocorrelation). Advisory: nothing is applied to any bot.
Simulated fills (buys and sells) in chronological order.

get.description: Equity curve marked at every candle close (empty until the run completes).

schema.title: Response Get Equity Api V1 Backtests  Run Id  Equity Get

post.description: Create a paper-trading bot. It starts stopped; call ``/start`` to run it.

schema.title: Response List Bots Api V1 Bots Get

get.description: Equity, PnL and fees added up per execution mode and quote currency (never mixed).

schema.title: Response Get Summary Api V1 Bots Summary Get

get.description: Every bot with its current equity and return, for side-by-side comparison.

schema.title: Response Get Overview Api V1 Bots Overview Get

patch.description: Change the configuration of a stopped bot (creates a new config version).

delete.description:
Delete a stopped bot with its orders, signals, portfolio and history. The audit trail
keeps a `bot.deleted` event. Live bots and bots with an open position are refused (409).

post.description:
Ask the worker to run the bot (or resume it). Poll the bot for ``observed_state``.

A **live** bot needs `confirmation_token` every time it starts (see live-approvals).

get.description: The checklist a bot must pass before it may trade real money (all items must be ok).

post.description:
Point a stopped bot at a live connection. This does NOT start trading: it still needs
the readiness checklist and a one-time approval.

Step 1 of starting a live bot: pass the checklist and type its name. Returns a token that
is single-use, short-lived and valid only for the bot's current configuration.
Stop evaluating the strategy; the session and its state are kept.
End the session. The virtual portfolio (including any open position) is kept.
Restart the virtual portfolio from the initial capital (stopped bots only).

schema.title: Response Get Orders Api V1 Bots  Bot Id  Orders Get

get.description: Strategy signals and what the risk layer decided (approved / rejected / discarded_stale).

schema.title: Response Get Signals Api V1 Bots  Bot Id  Signals Get

get.description: Performance metrics net of fees (null until the bot has produced a snapshot).

schema.title: Response Get Performance Api V1 Bots  Bot Id  Performance Get
Response Get Equity Api V1 Bots  Bot Id  Equity Get

get.description: Realized slippage and latency of the bot's filled orders against its assumption.

post.description:
Queue a replay of the bot's latest session through the backtester (the worker runs it)
and a comparison of signals and trades. Read-only: the bot is not affected.

schema.title: Response Get Parity Api V1 Bots  Bot Id  Parity Get

post.description:
Record why this bot was paused, changed or retired. Stored in the audit trail
(`note.added`); read it with `GET /audit-events?event_type=note.added&entity_id={bot_id}`.

get.description:
Compare the bot's realized Sharpe with the backtest of its configuration (the newest
completed one with the same strategy parameters, or ``run_id``). Read-only.

Chan's checklist for "why does it differ from the backtest?", in his order. Never
concludes bad luck: it cannot be proven.

schema.title: Response Get Divergence Api V1 Bots  Bot Id  Divergence Get

put.description:
Emergency stop. While active, the worker pauses every running bot and no new entries
are approved. Releasing it does not resume bots: start them again explicitly.

get.description: Is live trading possible here, and if not, what is missing? Contains no secrets.
Is the worker alive and is every running bot advancing? Poll this from a monitor.

Append-only trail of commands, state changes, orders and risk events (newest first).
The size of the whole trail that matches is in ``X-Total-Count``.

schema.title: Response List Audit Events Api V1 Audit Events Get

get.description:
Failure alerts, newest first. An alert stays until it is resolved and read; the size of
the whole list that matches is in ``X-Total-Count``.

schema.title: Response List Alerts Api V1 Alerts Get

get.description: Unread alerts and the alerts still open (without resolution), for the header indicator.

schema.title: Response List Connections Api V1 Exchange Connections Get

post.description:
Register exchange credentials. They are stored encrypted, only the worker can decrypt
them, and they are never returned. **Live** keys start `pending`: the worker checks what
they may do and refuses any key that can withdraw or transfer funds.
Stop using these credentials. Bots bound to a disabled connection cannot start.

Ask the exchange now what this ACTIVE key may do (the worker also does it daily).

A key that turned unacceptable keeps working for exits but gets ``permission_warning``,
which blocks new entries until it is fixed and checked again.

confirm_name.title: Confirm Name
confirm_name.description: Type the bot's exact name to confirm you mean it

confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token
confirmation_token.description: Shown once. Valid for one start of this version

fee_rate.title: Fee Rate
fee_rate.description: Fraction of notional (0.001 = 0.1%). Defaults to the exchange's taker fee.

slippage_bps.title: Slippage Bps
slippage_bps.description: Adverse slippage per fill, in bps

slippage_model.description: `fixed` (default, one number per run, what the bots use) or `volatility_size`: adds to slippage_bps with the candle's range and the order's share of the candle's traded value. The extra cost only worsens the fill.

slippage_k_range.title: Slippage K Range
slippage_k_range.description: Extra bps per bps of candle range (high-low over open). Calibrate with the realized slippage of your bots; there is no default.

slippage_k_size.title: Slippage K Size
slippage_k_size.description: Extra bps per bps of the order's share of the candle's traded value.

test_fraction.title: Test Fraction
test_fraction.description: Hold out this share of the series (at the end) as an out-of-sample test part. Train and test metrics are then reported separately in `segments`.

cost_sensitivity.title: Cost Sensitivity
cost_sensitivity.description: Also re-run the backtest with fee and slippage scaled by 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2 and 3 and report the break-even cost in `cost_ladder`. Slower; limited to 50,000 candles.

max_drawdown_tolerance_pct.title: Max Drawdown Tolerance Pct
max_drawdown_tolerance_pct.description: Deepest drawdown the operator accepts; `tolerance` flags runs beyond it.

max_drawdown_tolerance_days.title: Max Drawdown Tolerance Days
max_drawdown_tolerance_days.description: Longest drawdown (days below the peak) the operator accepts.

fill_timing.description: `next_open`: fill at the next candle's open (default). `signal_close`: fill at the close of the signal candle, like the bots do (use it to compare with a bot).

risk.description: Size and pause exactly like a bot with these limits (the bot's risk module). Null keeps the all-in sizing.

resume_daily_pause.title: Resume Daily Pause
resume_daily_pause.description: With `risk`: lift a daily-loss pause when the next UTC day starts, as an operator who resumes the bot every morning would. Drawdown and loss-streak pauses stay.

allow_gaps.title: Allow Gaps
allow_gaps.description: Run even when the range misses more than 1% of its candles or has a hole longer than 24 h (otherwise 422). The gaps are reported in `data_quality.gaps`.

prior_runs.title: Prior Runs
prior_runs.description: Detail only: other completed runs of the same strategy on overlapping data (same exchange, symbol and timeframe). Each look at the same window makes its test part less out of sample.

overdue.title: Overdue
overdue.description: No successful backup in 26 h, or the last restore check failed.

fee_rate.title: Fee Rate
fee_rate.description: Defaults to the exchange's taker fee

connection_id.title: Connection Id
connection_id.description: Required for testnet bots: the exchange connection to use

BotUpdate.title: BotUpdate
BotUpdate.description: Every field optional. Only allowed while the bot is stopped.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the operator registered the break: after the run means it was chosen with the results in view.

CapabilitiesOut.title: CapabilitiesOut
CapabilitiesOut.description:
What this deployment allows, so the UI can explain instead of letting a user try and fail.
It reflects the API process's configuration; the worker enforces its own on every pass.

skew_ms.title: Skew Ms
skew_ms.description: Local clock minus the exchange's, in ms.

blocking_live.title: Blocking Live
blocking_live.description: Beyond 5 s: no new live positions are opened.

confirm_real_money.title: Confirm Real Money
confirm_real_money.description: Required for environment=live: these keys can spend REAL money

permissions.description: What the key could do at the last check.

status_reason.title: Status Reason
status_reason.description: Why the last check refused the key (null when accepted).

permission_warning.title: Permission Warning
permission_warning.description: An ACTIVE key that later became unacceptable: new entries are refused, exits continue, until the key is fixed and checked again.

ConnectionOut.title: ConnectionOut
ConnectionOut.description: What the API ever returns about a connection: no secret, only a hint of the key.

break_even_cost_per_side_bps.title: Break Even Cost Per Side Bps

gaps.title: Gaps
gaps.description: Gaps of the whole stored series.

in_range.description: Gaps inside start/end, when both were given.

outliers.title: Outliers
outliers.description: Close-to-close moves beyond outlier_sigmas std. deviations.

DataQualityOut.title: DataQualityOut
DataQualityOut.description: What the result rests on. Older runs miss some or all of it.

DrawdownAction.title: DrawdownAction
DrawdownAction.description:
What a bot does when ``max_drawdown_pct`` is breached (book 2 ch. 8, O2).

``pause`` waits for the operator and can simply be resumed; ``stop`` ends the session, because
a budget that is spent ends the strategy. Either way the position is kept and exits stay
allowed.

worst_pct.title: Worst Pct
worst_pct.description: Deepest drop below the entry, in percent.

by_type.title: By Type
by_type.description: Per order type: orders, slippage_bps {mean, median, worst}, latency_ms {mean, max}.

above_configured.title: Above Configured
above_configured.description: Realized market-order slippage above the assumption (+1 bps tolerance).

ruin_fraction.title: Ruin Fraction
ruin_fraction.description: 1 / |worst return|: above this one bar wipes the account out.

bootstrap_returns.title: Bootstrap Returns
bootstrap_returns.description: Returns resampled by the bootstrap (the latest ones, capped).

growth.title: Growth
growth.description: Mean log growth per bar at this exposure; null when it would wipe the account.

FillTiming.title: FillTiming
FillTiming.description:
When a signal is filled (book 1 ch. 5): at the next candle's open (the backtest's
default), or at the close of the signal candle, which is what the bots do.

significant_corrected.title: Significant Corrected
significant_corrected.description: |z| reaches the Bonferroni-corrected level of the whole grid.

sample_every.title: Sample Every
sample_every.description: One close per this many candles (1 = every candle).

hurst.title: Hurst
hurst.description: Hurst exponent by the variance-of-differences method: below 0.5 reverts, 0.5 is a random walk, above 0.5 trends. Null on a short series.

suggested_windows.title: Suggested Windows
suggested_windows.description: Look-back windows around the half-life (0.5x, 1x, 2x), in the sampled bars; empty unless the series looks stationary at 5%. A search range, not advice.

variance_ratios.title: Variance Ratios
variance_ratios.description: Variance ratio per lag: below 1 reverts, 1 random walk, above 1 trends. z_stat assumes constant volatility, which crypto does not have.

candles_rejected.title: Candles Rejected
candles_rejected.description: Invalid candles (e.g. high below close) that were not stored.

candles_changed.title: Candles Changed
candles_changed.description: Stored candles the exchange now reports differently (updated).

rejection_samples.title: Rejection Samples
rejection_samples.description: Up to 20 rejected candles with their problem codes.

end.title: End
end.description: Exclusive. Candles still in progress are skipped

JobStatus.title: JobStatus
JobStatus.description: Lifecycle shared by the DB-backed jobs the worker executes.

first_seen.title: First Seen
first_seen.description: First daily snapshot that listed the pair.

sharpe_ratio.title: Sharpe Ratio
sharpe_ratio.description: Annualised (365 days), risk-free rate 0. Null below 30 returns.

information_ratio.title: Information Ratio
information_ratio.description: Sharpe of the excess return over holding the same asset.

annualized_return_pct.title: Annualized Return Pct
annualized_return_pct.description: Geometric; null for spans shorter than 30 days.

exposure_pct.title: Exposure Pct
exposure_pct.description: Share of bars with an open position.

return_periods.title: Return Periods
return_periods.description: Number of periodic returns behind the ratios.

return_gaps.title: Return Gaps
return_gaps.description: Steps skipped because the equity curve had a hole.

max_drawdown_duration_seconds.title: Max Drawdown Duration Seconds
max_drawdown_duration_seconds.description: Longest time from a peak until equity was back at it.

drawdown_open.title: Drawdown Open
drawdown_open.description: The curve ends below its high watermark (not recovered).

sharpe_t_stat.title: Sharpe T Stat
sharpe_t_stat.description: Mean return / std * sqrt(n) of the periodic returns (Gaussian test, book 2 ch. 1). Null below 30 returns.

significance_p.title: Significance P
significance_p.description: Strictest p-value of the Gaussian table (0.10, 0.05, 0.01, 0.001) that the statistic reaches; null when it does not reach 0.10. Not the chance that the strategy works.

alpha_corrected.title: Alpha Corrected
alpha_corrected.description: 0.05 divided by the number of cells.

reference_price.title: Reference Price
reference_price.description: Price of the decision: signal candle close or stop trigger.

slippage_bps.title: Slippage Bps
slippage_bps.description: Adverse move from the reference to the fill (bps).

reference_return_pct.title: Reference Return Pct
reference_return_pct.description: Same-candle move of the reference pair: if it also moved, it was probably a market-wide move, not bad data.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: counts by class, verdict, differences, returns, replay_equity.

granularity.title: Granularity
granularity.description: `year`, or `quarter` when the run spans < 2 years.

connection_id.title: Connection Id
connection_id.description: An ACTIVE live connection of the bot's exchange

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the test was not computed (too few trades).

as_good_or_better.title: As Good Or Better
as_good_or_better.description: Simulations with random entries that did as well or better.

fraction.title: Fraction
fraction.description: as_good_or_better / simulations: a small value means luck is an unlikely explanation. It is not the chance that the strategy works.

overlap_allowed.title: Overlap Allowed
overlap_allowed.description: Random trades are drawn independently and may overlap.

expected.title: Expected
expected.description: Closed candles the range should have.

largest_gap.title: Largest Gap
largest_gap.description: Candles missing in the largest single hole.

sharpe.title: Sharpe
sharpe.description: Annualised (365 days); null on a short sample.

return_periods.title: Return Periods
return_periods.description: The size of the live sample.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: The backtest compared with; null if none matches.

min_periods.title: Min Periods
min_periods.description: Live returns needed before a ratio is given.

chan_min_ratio.title: Chan Min Ratio
chan_min_ratio.description: Chan's rule of thumb (his experience, not a standard): a ratio of at least this is usually acceptable.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why there is no ratio, when there is none.

max_order_pct_of_volume.title: Max Order Pct Of Volume
max_order_pct_of_volume.description: Cap an order at this % of the average traded value of the last 20 candles (Chan's rule of thumb: ~1% of daily volume, for stocks). Null = off.

max_close_jump_pct.title: Max Close Jump Pct
max_close_jump_pct.description: Refuse entries when the close moved more than this % from the previous close (a bad tick often looks like a jump). Exits are never refused. Null = off.

drawdown_action.description: What happens when max_drawdown_pct is breached: `pause` (resume by hand) or `stop` (ends the session; to start again, reset the portfolio with a reason, which also starts a new drawdown peak). The position is kept either way.

RiskLimitsIn-Input.title: RiskLimitsIn
RiskLimitsIn-Input.description: A bot's risk limits; also accepted by backtests to size and pause exactly like the bot.

max_order_pct_of_volume.title: Max Order Pct Of Volume
max_order_pct_of_volume.description: Cap an order at this % of the average traded value of the last 20 candles (Chan's rule of thumb: ~1% of daily volume, for stocks). Null = off.

max_close_jump_pct.title: Max Close Jump Pct
max_close_jump_pct.description: Refuse entries when the close moved more than this % from the previous close (a bad tick often looks like a jump). Exits are never refused. Null = off.

drawdown_action.description: What happens when max_drawdown_pct is breached: `pause` (resume by hand) or `stop` (ends the session; to start again, reset the portfolio with a reason, which also starts a new drawdown peak). The position is kept either way.

RiskLimitsIn-Output.title: RiskLimitsIn
RiskLimitsIn-Output.description: A bot's risk limits; also accepted by backtests to size and pause exactly like the bot.

min_bars.title: Min Bars
min_bars.description: 252 x free parameters (Chan's rule of thumb).

SlippageModel.title: SlippageModel
SlippageModel.description:
How the backtest prices slippage. ``fixed`` is one number per run (and what the paper
trader uses); ``volatility_size`` adds to it with the candle's range and the order's size
against the candle's traded value (book 2 ch. 7, O2).

confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token
confirmation_token.description: Live bots only: the single-use token from POST /bots/{id}/live-approvals

key.title: Key
key.description: bugs | trades | costs | liquidity | snooping | regime

parameter_count.title: Parameter Count
parameter_count.description: Configurable parameters. Chan's rule of thumb: at most 5 (book 1 ch. 3).

StrategyStyle.title: StrategyStyle
StrategyStyle.description: The family a strategy belongs to: it decides which tests and warnings apply to it.

fee_rate.title: Fee Rate
fee_rate.description: Fraction of notional (0.001 = 0.1%). Defaults to the exchange's taker fee.

slippage_bps.title: Slippage Bps
slippage_bps.description: Adverse slippage per fill, in bps

slippage_model.description: `fixed` (default, one number per run, what the bots use) or `volatility_size`: adds to slippage_bps with the candle's range and the order's share of the candle's traded value. The extra cost only worsens the fill.

slippage_k_range.title: Slippage K Range
slippage_k_range.description: Extra bps per bps of candle range (high-low over open). Calibrate with the realized slippage of your bots; there is no default.

slippage_k_size.title: Slippage K Size
slippage_k_size.description: Extra bps per bps of the order's share of the candle's traded value.

test_fraction.title: Test Fraction
test_fraction.description: Hold out this share of the series (at the end) as an out-of-sample test part. Train and test metrics are then reported separately in `segments`.

cost_sensitivity.title: Cost Sensitivity
cost_sensitivity.description: Also re-run the backtest with fee and slippage scaled by 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2 and 3 and report the break-even cost in `cost_ladder`. Slower; limited to 50,000 candles.

max_drawdown_tolerance_pct.title: Max Drawdown Tolerance Pct
max_drawdown_tolerance_pct.description: Deepest drawdown the operator accepts; `tolerance` flags runs beyond it.

max_drawdown_tolerance_days.title: Max Drawdown Tolerance Days
max_drawdown_tolerance_days.description: Longest drawdown (days below the peak) the operator accepts.

fill_timing.description: `next_open`: fill at the next candle's open (default). `signal_close`: fill at the close of the signal candle, like the bots do (use it to compare with a bot).

risk.description: Size and pause exactly like a bot with these limits (the bot's risk module). Null keeps the all-in sizing.

resume_daily_pause.title: Resume Daily Pause
resume_daily_pause.description: With `risk`: lift a daily-loss pause when the next UTC day starts, as an operator who resumes the bot every morning would. Drawdown and loss-streak pauses stay.

allow_gaps.title: Allow Gaps
allow_gaps.description: Run even when the range misses more than 1% of its candles or has a hole longer than 24 h (otherwise 422). The gaps are reported in `data_quality.gaps`.

grid.title: Grid
grid.description: Parameter name -> values to try. One run per combination (max 200). The special key `start_offset_days` (up to 25 distinct whole days) shifts the start of each run instead: how much does the result depend on the day it began?

trials.title: Trials
trials.description: Parameter combinations tried, including skipped ones.

prior_trials.title: Prior Trials
prior_trials.description: Approximate: earlier completed runs of the same strategy on overlapping data (same exchange, symbol and timeframe) outside this sweep.

start.title: Start
start.description: The run's own start (shifted in a start-sensitivity sweep).

unprotected_positions.title: Unprotected Positions
unprotected_positions.description: Testnet/live positions with no stop resting on the exchange: exposed while the worker is down.

TokenOut.title: TokenOut
TokenOut.description:
Keep ``access_token`` in memory and send it as ``Authorization: Bearer``. The refresh
token travels only in an httpOnly cookie, out of reach of page scripts.

exceeded_duration.title: Exceeded Duration
exceeded_duration.description: Null when the run predates drawdown duration (not computed).

stop_price.title: Stop Price
stop_price.description: Stop watched by the worker only (none on the exchange), when set.

can_write.title: Can Write
can_write.description: May this user change anything? The server enforces it; the UI only reflects it.
